title: Writing --- Four Lines, And The Gap Inside A Word
label: ch:fa-four-lines
canDo: I can write four connected lines of Persian to a named reader, setting one thing against another with vali and giving a reason with chon.

payoff.summary: Complete FA-W289-chahar-khat: four lines to one reader, at least one with vali and one with chon, then check the spacing around every vav.
payoff.note: Both joiners carry vav, which never joins to the letter on its left, so each word has a gap inside it. Spacing becomes part of the spelling: the gap between words must be wider than the break inside one.
